data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Mendon's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FRST, USCB, and FCBM.

One recent public signal: FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on September 18, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
